title: Mental Reset Walk (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-jazz-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 130bpm slap bass Rhodes sax muted trumpet dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Last point gone last point gone
Walk it off and carry on
Last point gone last point gone
Reset the mind move along

[Verse 1]
Three steps back away from the line
Shake the paddle let it swing in time
Eyes on the strings adjust the band
Breath in three out three calm and grand
Vamos vamos walk it back
Reset the mind erase the track
The last point lives only in the past
This next point is the only one that lasts

[Pre-Chorus]
Gone gone gone gone
Last point gone
Gone gone gone gone
Move along

[Chorus]
Mental reset between the points
Walk and breath the mind anoints
Mental reset shake the score
This next point matters more
Vamos vamos pa lante
Reset the mind
Vamos vamos pa lante
Leave the past behind

[Verse 2]
Dont talk down to your inner voice
Every rally is a brand new choice
Serve coming up reset the slate
Nothing in the past can change your fate
Uno dos tres breath count steady
Uno dos tres ready ready
Next ball next ball next ball next
Mental reset is the test

[Bridge]
Two seconds is all it takes
Walk the line shake what aches
Clear the score from the head
Focus forward step ahead

[Chorus]
Mental reset between the points
Walk and breath the mind anoints
Mental reset shake the score
This next point matters more

[Outro]
Last point gone last point gone
Walk it off and carry on
Last point gone last point gone
Reset the mind move along
